note: Pitch step 5: a slow slide on "oo" from the low Do to the high Do over a drone, then the same distance as one clean leap, with a feel to reach and a care line. The key is moves, with a {{?key}} line on what stays the same.

exercise.title: Slide to the high Do
exercise.why: A slow slide passes through every pitch between two notes, so it shows your voice the whole distance before you leap it.

cells.text:
Press Start exercise below: the drone and the mic start together, and your pitch shows as a line on the staff. Slide slowly from the low {{1}} up to the high {{1}} and back, like a siren, and watch your line pass {{5}} on the way. Sing it on "oo".
Then sing the two as one clean leap. Practice until the leap lands on the high {{1}} without a slide.
_Don't reach for high notes: keep the slide quiet, and stop where your throat tightens._
{{?key}}In another key the drone sits higher or lower, and the slide still spans one octave.
